pages.title: T Cell
pages.text: $(thing)T Cell$(): A killer lymphocyte on patrol. It leaves you alone, unless you carry an infection: then you glow in the Lymph Node and it hunts you down. It hunts the anomalies that infect, and the Tumour Hydra, too. Found in the Lymph Node of Inner Space.$(br2)$(thing)Drops$(): Memory Cell, Antibody.
